name: mcp-nokotime
description: A Nokotime integration for Model Context Protocol

scripts.build:mcpb: mkdir -p bundle/dist && npm run build && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=bundle/dist/index.js --format=cjs && cp manifest.json bundle/ && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('bundle/package.json', JSON.stringify({name:'mcp-nokotime',version:'0.1.0',main:'dist/index.js'}))" && (cd bundle && npx mcpb pack && mv bundle.mcpb ../mcp-nokotime.mcpb)
